hebrewText: וְ/נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖/וֹ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֵּ֖ית חֲל֥וּץ הַ/נָּֽעַל

tokens.bdb: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanation: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen
tokens.kjv: arm (self), (go, ready) armed ([idiom] man, soldier), deliver, draw out, make fat, loose, (ready) prepared, put off, take away, withdraw self.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to pull off; hence  to strip
tokens.enLiteralWord: to pull off; hence  to strip
tokens.explanation: to pull off; hence  to strip
tokens.explanationEn: to pull off; hence  to strip

tokens.bdb: properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless)
